declarations.type:
∀ {n : Nat} (A R : Matrix.{0, 0, 0} (Fin n) (Fin n) Real) (u : Real) (fp : Cholesky.FloatingPoint u),
  Matrix.IsSymm.{0, 0} A →
    Matrix.PosDef.{0, 0} A →
      LE.le.{0} 0 u →
        LT.lt.{0} (HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} (↑(HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} n 1)) u) 1 →
          Cholesky.SuccessfulRun fp A R →
            Cholesky.NoOverflowUnderflow fp A R →
              ∃ ΔA,
                And (Matrix.IsSymm.{0, 0} ΔA)
                  (And (Eq.{1} (HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} (Matrix.transpose.{0, 0, 0} R) R) (HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} A ΔA))
                    (∀ (i j : Fin n),
